prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: seamless PBR base-colour texture for the silver metal LPG canister on an old industrial forklift in the Lowtide dockyard game map. One square full-bleed material image, intended as a 2048 x 2048 texture.
Primary request: generate a realistic flat albedo scan of gently worn satin bare aluminium, replacing a blurry mottled procedural silver material. The metal should remain a restrained medium-light neutral silver-grey, with slight warm dusty aging, and clearly read as smooth metal.
Materials/textures: fine subtle brushed machining grain, mostly smooth intact satin metal, crisp shallow hairline scratches of varied direction, a few small handling scuffs, sparse tiny darker oxidation freckles, very light dried workshop grime and dusty smudges. Wear must be understated, sharp and natural; about 94 percent clean intact metal. Extremely low relief. No coarse pores, pebbled texture, hammered dents, rust crust or leather-like grain. No large dark cloudy stains or camouflage blobs. No special edge damage because this material wraps around a cylinder and the model supplies the shape.
Composition/framing: perfectly flat orthographic material scan; same continuous material fills every pixel; consistent scale and detail all the way to all four edges; tileable with no visible seams.
Lighting: completely even diffuse albedo only; no directional light, specular highlights, baked reflections, shadow, vignette or ambient occlusion. The engine will generate the curved canister reflections.
Color palette: muted neutral silver-grey aluminium around RGB 155-165, sparse mid-grey scratches and dust, no strong blue or yellow cast, no white polished chrome, no orange rust areas.
Constraints: texture only, not an image or render of a bottle, panel, canister or forklift. No cylinder silhouette, curvature, seams, straps, borders, screws, bolts, fittings, valve, text, decals, logos, watermark, background, perspective, geometry, PBR collage or texture-map grid.
